thesis: A prospective protocol makes every assumption, resource, test and interpretation explicit before results arrive.
role: Turn the program into a reusable investigation form.

ideas.statement: An investigation needs rival outcomes, disclosed observation access and resources, fixed contracts, controls and advance interpretation rules.
Report proof, empirical support, refutation and untested questions separately while retaining failures and identifying post hoc hypothesis changes.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Supplied correct structure diagnoses representation utility rather than autonomous discovery.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
